Class SecurityConfig

java.lang.Object
com.model.SecurityConfig
public class SecurityConfig extends Object
Stores and manages the security configuration for the Masroofy application. Handles PIN hashing and verification, lockout state, and failed attempt tracking.

      public SecurityConfig()

    • SecurityConfig

      public SecurityConfig(String hashedPIN, boolean isLockEnabled, int failedAttempts, LocalDateTime lockoutEndTime)
      Constructs a SecurityConfig with the specified security state.
      Parameters:
      hashedPIN - the stored hashed PIN string
      isLockEnabled - whether the privacy lock is enabled
      failedAttempts - the number of consecutive failed attempts
      lockoutEndTime - the time when the lockout ends, or null if not locked
